# clerk_machine (Resource)

Manages a Clerk machine.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "clerk_machine" "service" {
  name              = "Backend Service"
  default_token_ttl = 3600
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the machine.

### Optional

- `default_token_ttl` (Number) Default token TTL in seconds for this machine.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the machine was created.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the machine.
- `secret_key` (String, Sensitive) Machine secret key. Write-only: only returned on creation, not on subsequent reads.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the machine was last updated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import clerk_machine.example <machine_id>
```
